claims.evidence: Witness describes a single long seat cushion and calls it a '3-seater bench-style sofa'; actual seat count is not clearly shown, so the 2-seater claim can't be confirmed from the photos.
No date, receipt, or wear-pattern detail in the photos can confirm age.
Photo 1 explicitly shows faint stains on the seat cushion.
No tears visible in the two angles shown, but undersides, back, and seams are not photographed.
Firmness cannot be judged from a static photo; would need a video of the cushion being pressed or sat on.
Smell/history cannot be assessed remotely at all.

risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of the entire seat and backrest under good lighting, plus any other cushions

risks.risk: Actual seat count / size mismatch (2 vs 3 seater)
risks.proof: Full straight-on photo with a tape measure or known reference object showing total length and cushion divisions
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value seat configuration shown (bench-style, ambiguous count)

risks.risk: Hidden tears, rips, or repairs on back/underside
risks.proof: Photos of the underside, back panel, and zipper/seam areas
Short video of someone sitting on it or pressing the cushion firmly
Photo of legs/frame and a video of the sofa being shaken or lightly pushed
No remote proof possible; only an in-person check at pickup
risks.if_unproven: priced as a smoke/odor risk unresolved

proof_requests: Full straight-on photo with a measuring tape or ruler showing total sofa length and seat divisions
Close-up photos of all stains, seams, and the underside/back of the sofa
Video of the cushion being pressed and the sofa being lightly shaken to check foam and frame
Photo of the sofa's legs and frame material
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a bench-style sofa, but the seller's 'no stain' claim is directly contradicted by the photos and seat count is ambiguous, so it must be priced at worst case (stained, uncertain configuration) pending further proof.
